units.title: Software used in Graphic Design
topics: 1.1. Introduction of Graphic Design Software: Definition, types, applications
1.2. Capabilities of Graphic Design Software: Handling text, generation of graphics, editing of images, output.
1.3. System requirement: Hardware and software environment required for Graphic Design software like Hardware, Operating System, printer, scanner.

units.title: Vector Based Software
topics: 2.1. Definition of vector graphics, characteristics and applications.
2.2. Introduction of Tools and Menu of Adobe Illustrator and CorelDRAW software
2.3. Identify interface, palettes and color mode, handling various text and apply different formatting, Place, Import, and export various contents
2.4. Prepare Illustrations and logos using different tools and effects
2.5. Set the file for printing equipment.

units.title: Image editing software
topics: 3.1. Definition of raster (bitmap) graphics, characteristics and application
3.2. Introduction of Tools and Menu of Adobe Photoshop software

3.3. Identify interface, palettes, and color mode. Handlings layer and apply different options like masking, cutout, image resolution and import various contents. Color separation, flattening, preflight check.
3.4. Photograph editing and Color Correction and Image creation in Adobe Photoshop
3.5. Set the file for printing equipment.

units.title: Imposition Software
topics: 4.1. Concept of imposition: Concept and need of imposition. Elements of a standard imposition schemes and their applications, Comparison of different types of imposition schemes in layout.
4.2. Introduction of Adobe InDesign software and its features, Tools and Menu.
4.3. Introduction of Quark Express software and its features, Tools and Menu.
4.4. Tools and menus of ArtiosCAD
